title: CCF docs instances manifest (instances.yaml)
description: One versioned Docusaurus docs plugin instance per CCF repository. Read by docusaurus.config.ts and scripts/gen-sidebars.mjs, and kept in sync by the docs-release skill. Ids, paths and routes must also be unique across instances; scripts/instances.mjs checks that.

onlyIncludeVersions.description: How many of the newest released minor lines each kind builds; older lines are archived. Without it, every line is built.

id.description: The docs plugin id. It names the instance's files: <id>_versioned_docs/, <id>_versions.json and sidebars/<id>.ts.

path.description: The directory of the current (unreleased) docs, relative to the docs repository root.

route.description: The URL path under the site's baseUrl, without leading or trailing slashes.

label.description: The name shown in the navbar and the catalog.

navbar.description: Show the instance and its version dropdown in the navbar.

openapi.description: Where the repository keeps its OpenAPI spec.

source.description: The spec's path inside the repository at the release tag.

policies.description: The policy repositories whose bundles belong to this plugin, listed explicitly because the names don't always line up.
